# DRAFT: Medical device adverse incident report

> This is a draft for human review. It has not been submitted. A manufacturer would report
> through the MHRA MORE portal; healthcare professionals and users report through the Yellow Card scheme.

## 1. Device
- Name: ClinicDrift-monitored DR screening model
- Version: v1.0
- Intended use: screening retinal photographs for referable diabetic retinopathy

## 2. Where and when
- Clinic: FR-MES-01 (France)
- Period: week 1 (starting 2026-01-05)

## 3. What happened
ClinicDrift identified that the scans from this clinic no longer resemble the data the AI was validated on, showing a drift score of 0.99 (where 0.5 indicates similarity to training data and 1 indicates a clear difference). 

As a result, the catch rate cannot be verified using the 50 scans from this week, and expert grades for these scans are not yet available. The AI is currently referring a higher proportion of patients than usual, accounting for 80% of this week's scans compared with 68% of the training scans.

## 4. Potential patient impact
As the catch rate cannot be verified, no estimate has been made for the number of possibly missed cases. No patient harm has been confirmed.

## 5. Likely cause
Significant deviations in image quality metrics, resolution, and camera parameters compared with the training data. (Category: camera or image quality; confidence 95%; source: gemini)

Evidence:
- Drift score is 0.99, indicating scans no longer resemble the training data.
- Mean brightness changed from 0.373 to 0.328 (relative change -0.119).
- Mean contrast changed from 0.0963 to 0.0564 (relative change -0.414).
- Mean sharpness changed from 0.000399 to 0.000213 (relative change -0.467).
- Mean quality changed from 0.5 to 0.198 (relative change -0.604).
- Mean resolution changed from 1020.0 px to 2010.0 px (relative change 0.967).
- Referral rate increased from 0.685 to 0.8 (relative change 0.169).

## 6. Action
ClinicDrift paused the AI at this clinic because the scans have drifted beyond the validated baseline, meaning the catch rate cannot be verified. It is recommended that scans from this clinic are sent for human grading until the following checks are complete:

Checks:
- [ ] Verify camera hardware settings and firmware updates at clinic FR-MES-01.
- [ ] Check lens cleanliness and correct focus calibration.
- [ ] Review image capture protocols and export settings to ensure resolution and compression match training baselines.

## 7. Regulatory context
- Post-market surveillance (PMS): this alarm forms part of ongoing monitoring of the device in use.
- Predetermined change control plan (PCCP): any model changes made in response must fall within an agreed PCCP.
- MHRA AI Airlock Phase 2 report: refer to recommendations 3 and 4.

## 8. MIT AI Risk Repository tags
- 7.3 AI system safety, failures & limitations > Lack of capability or robustness
- 1.3 Discrimination & toxicity > Unequal performance across groups
- 5.1 Human-computer interaction > Overreliance and unsafe use
